name: [UPDATE 2!] Kick an Uma
desc:
🐎 Welcome to Kick an Uma!

How to Play:

💥 Build up your Kick Power and send Umas FLYING!
🌎 Kick farther to reach new zones and discover rarer Umas!
💰 Collect Umas and place them in your base to earn Cash!
🏋️ Upgrade your Power, unlock better Weights, and kick even farther!
✨ Discover rare Umas and complete your collection!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
